content: Should we use SQLite WAL mode or RocksDB for the knowledge graph?
Decided on SQLite WAL mode for concurrent multi-agent read/write. Rejected RocksDB due to operational complexity and DuckDB due to lack of concurrent write support.
Will SQLite WAL mode block the Tauri UI if a large batch is being ingested?
Verified SQLite WAL allows concurrent readers on Tauri UI thread while worker thread writes batches. No blocking expected.
